title: Measure completed federation fixture writer bookkeeping instead of leaving a default zero
outcome: Completed federation fixture writer observations report the time actually spent in the existing bookkeeping phase, preserving observer and fence semantics.
acceptance: The fixture measures bookkeeping with the existing observer and the production phase boundary, or explicitly represents it as unmeasured; completed omission/readback work is not reported as a measured zero.
A deterministic focused control exercises the omission bookkeeping path without sleeps or timeout changes and verifies phase attribution while preserving exact durable-content checks.
